name: Aoncos

attributes.attribute: a magical island of the Irish Otherworld held aloft by a silver pillar

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Aoncos is an Irish mythological site. It is one of the many magical islands of the Irish Otherworld. A silver pillar held the island aloft above the ocean waves.
objective: Record Aoncos, a magical Irish island.
key_results: Show the silver pillar that held it aloft above the waves.
